verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents what happens when a plan's automation or API call limits are exceeded: no overage charges, no throttling or rate-limit behavior, and no hard-stop policy. The only nearby item is the ability to track AI credit spend in an admin dashboard. That is an adjacent monitoring feature, not documentation of over-limit consequences, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know what happens—extra charges, throttling, or a hard stop—when I exceed my plan's automation or API call limits
